title: Image upload reaches TIFF/JPEG heap overwrite (potential RCE)
vulnerabilityInformation: A critical heap buffer overflow vulnerability was identified in an image processing library. The vulnerability was triggered when a TIFF container with a one byte per pixel component count was paired with an embedded JPEG output requiring two bytes per pixel. This mismatch resulted in a deterministic heap buffer overwrite. Proof-of-concept files were provided demonstrating the issue, and control-flow hijacking was demonstrated as a potential exploitation method.
